verdict.rationale: The core Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is proprietary silicon with closed-source drivers/SDKs (Quark, Ryzen AI Software docs give no license info), but AMD does ship GAIA, described explicitly as 'AMD's open-source framework' for building local AI agents on this hardware, giving a thin sliver of openness evidence. missing for 10: explicit open-source license for the core Ryzen AI SDK/runtime, license terms for Quark/ONNX EP stack, and any independent confirmation of GAIA's actual open-source repo/license terms.
